disclosed_flaws: Light wear and scuffs at corners
Light wear and scuffs at edges
Light wear and residue at interior lining
Light wear and scratches at hardware
Mild rubbing at edges and corners
Possible minor care marks from routine maintenance
No box, dust bag, or documentation included
seller_speak_translation: "Light wear and scuffs" / "mild handling wear" — there is real, visible surface abrasion on the leather, not a single isolated mark. "Residue at interior lining" — the lining is soiled or has sticky/dirty buildup, i.e. staining. "Loss color at hardware" — the plating has worn off, which is permanent, not polishable. "Mild rubbing; structure remains firm" — the corners are abraded from use, the seller is reassuring that the bag hasn't gone soft. "May have received standard luxury care" / "minor care marks from routine maintenance" — the bag has likely been cleaned, refinished, or touched up, and that restoration work left its own visible marks. "Clean with light natural marks" — "natural" is a softening word for ordinary dirt and use marks. "Refer to the photos for an accurate impression" — the seller is shifting responsibility for assessing condition onto the buyer, implying the text understates what's visible.
